purpose: Split the causally active upstream MLP8 write into the exact gauge-invariant base-by-change and change-by-change parts of its bilinear computation, while preserving the established L11H3 current-value interface.

parent.finding: MLP8 alone passed both the standalone and conditional 25% Task14 margin-and-CE criteria in all four direction/template cells; number specificity held and large context dependence was null.

novelty_audit.relation: The canonical Task14 record localizes a useful write to MLP8 but contains no within-MLP8 bilinear response split.

The closest MLP8 work concerns a different equality-matcher circuit. Its native product indices failed natural-text transfer, closing term-index retuning rather than this Task14 input-response decomposition.
This selected equality-task native product coordinates on code and is neither Task14 nor an invariant branch-response factorial.
The code-selected equality terms failed natural transfer; this preregistration therefore does not select, rank, or tune native product coordinates.
This parked, unexecuted downstream MLP15/17 projector design is a different site and learned object.
Reuse exact_bilinear_response_terms for the already-tested algebra; no new generic intervention framework is needed.

data.position_meaning: the subject token and L11H3 self-source, not an arbitrary final-token convention

exact_computation.recipient_input: x_r is MLP8's actual normalized input at subject position 8
exact_computation.source_input: x_s is the opposite-number same-lemma input, or the same-number different-lemma control input, at the same position
exact_computation.write: Down is applied once to the selected product corner and Down_bias is added exactly once
exact_computation.propagation: the MLP8 write is multiplied by the native block-9, block-10, and block-11 residual coefficients before replacing only the MLP8 slot in the pre-attention-11 subject state
exact_computation.downstream_interface: recompute RMSNorm, L11 V head3 current branch, combine with recipient cached value, then use recipient p_8 and the recipient non-subject head complement before native suffix recomputation

backgrounds.standalone: MLP4--7 and MLP9--10 use recipient writes
backgrounds.conditional: MLP4--7 and MLP9--10 use opposite-number donor writes
backgrounds.lexical: other MLP4--10 writes use recipient values

predictions.pred_a_instrument_live: All algebra, gauge, propagation, parent-endpoint, replay, installation, and live full-MLP8 gates pass in both causal backgrounds.
predictions.pred_b_cross_dominant: The invariant base-by-change term recovers at least 70% of the full MLP8 CE and margin effect with at least 75% helpful rows in every task cell and both backgrounds, while the change-by-change term is at most 25%.
predictions.pred_c_quadratic_dominant: The invariant change-by-change term satisfies the same 70% criterion while the base-by-change term is at most 25%.
predictions.pred_d_distributed: Both invariant terms recover at least 25% in every task cell and background, while neither registered dominance account holds.
predictions.pred_e_downstream_interaction_needed: The CE or margin interaction after the two exact writes are combined reaches 25% of the full MLP8 effect in every task cell and background.
predictions.pred_f_background_stable: Cross and quadratic recovery each change by at most 25 percentage points between standalone and conditional backgrounds in every task cell and metric.
predictions.pred_g_number_specific: The same-number different-lemma full response is at most 25% of the opposite-number standalone full response for CE and margin in every cell.
predictions.pred_h_lexical_collateral: A same-number different-lemma full response reaches 50% of the opposite-number response in any cell.

gauge_limit: Independent reciprocal rescaling and Left/Right swapping of each native product leave t_cross and t_quad unchanged. Ordered Left-only and Right-only hybrid corners are therefore diagnostics only and cannot support semantic branch labels.
